name: Stuck with Me
original_name: คุณคือพรประการที่สาม
overview:
Maitree is a brilliant lawyer with a unique ability: she can stop time for ten minutes a day. Her unwavering confidence has earned her the nickname "100 Percent," and she excels in every aspect of her life. However, her pride is shaken when she loses a case to Manmek, a serene prosecutor who is hiding more than he lets on. Fate brings them together again when Manmek appears in her office as her new assistant, bringing sunflowers and an air of mystery. As they work together, Maitree can't help but be drawn to her. Manmek is different: she understands her, cares for her, and doesn't judge her, even when others consider her selfish.

But everything changes when Maitree receives a warning from her older sister, who can see the future. Someone is manipulating her into using her ability with dark secrets, and her life could be in danger. All signs point to Manmek… the woman she may be starting to fall in love with.

Adapted from the novel (คุณคือพรประการที่สาม) by Zezeho.
